_doc: Budgets checked by tests/perf_probe.gd (medians over 180 frames of the fixed clearing scene: day 1 11:00, clear, camera at the porch spawn, yaw 45, pitch -48, dist Balance.CAMERA_DIST (24 since G1), far 70). GPU timings (frame_ms_*) are only enforced when enforce_gpu is true: under xvfb + llvmpipe they are meaningless. See ARQ v2 §17.1 / §18.

perf_probe._primitives_note: G1: raised from 120000 to 270000 = the v2.1 art budget for a typical clearing view (docs/research/05_graficos_arte.md §4.5, ASSET_SPEC_V2 G1: HD hero assets). Draw calls, the real cost driver here, stay far below budget.

before_m0.note: Committed pre-M0 slice (GodotPhysics, v1 assets with one StandardMaterial3D per palette colour, camera far 260, CPUParticles3D). Measured with tests/perf_probe.gd on the untouched copy.

after_m0.note: M0 final (tests/run_all.sh): Jolt, v2 assets (COLOR_0 + palette_vcol -> shared world_vcol ShaderMaterial), camera far 70, compat preset (2048 atlas, 2 splits, 60 m), no shadows on small props / interior furniture, GPUParticles3D. draw_calls_max = 60 % of before_m0 (PLAN M0 acceptance).

new_code_old_v1_assets.note: Same M0 code but the pre-M0 v1 .glb files (legacy per-colour surfaces merged at load by Assets._merge_legacy), compat shadows at 45 m: shows the code-side share of the gain.

after_g1.note: G1 (HD hero assets v2.1 with baked AO in COLOR.a + world_vcol v2 / terrain shaders, FILMIC, camera dist 24). Measured by tests/run_all.sh on a clean clone (xvfb + Compatibility, 2 cores).
